title: Seattle #2106 operation orders and command chain
summary: Recover the native June/July 2026 operation orders, deployment tasking, command approvals, overtime/unit records and accountability material needed to identify the actual decision chain for 12th & Jackson and North Beacon Hill.

data.query: Who actually approved and commanded the June/July 2026 12th & Jackson and North Beacon Hill enforcement deployments, and what do native tasking/accountability records show about the decisions?
data.research_question: Who actually approved and commanded the June/July 2026 12th & Jackson and North Beacon Hill enforcement deployments, and what do native tasking/accountability records show about the decisions?
objectives: Recover operation orders, incident/action plans, deployment rosters and command approvals.
Recover relevant unit/watch tasking, overtime and interagency/service-provider coordination records.
Resolve dated West/South Precinct command and supervisor assignments from primary records.
Recover OPA/OIG/public-record findings tied to the actual operation and preserve exculpatory findings alongside adverse evidence.
out_of_scope: low-level personnel without material decision connection
